preconditions.description: The number of queries q is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(a) <= 10**5 for a in a_strings)
preconditions.description: Each string a in the queries has a length between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(b) <= 10**5 for b in b_strings)
preconditions.description: Each string b in the queries has a length between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in a) for a in a_strings)
preconditions.description: Each character in each string a is a lowercase English letter.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in b) for b in b_strings)
preconditions.description: Each character in each string b is a lowercase English letter.
The sum of lengths of all strings a does not exceed 200,000.
The sum of lengths of all strings b does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == '-1' or (is_palindrome(return_value[i]) and return_value[i] == max_palindromic_concatenation(a_strings[i], b_strings[i])) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query, the output is either '-1' or the lexicographically smallest longest palindromic string that can be formed by concatenating a non-empty substring of a and a non-empty substring of b.
